name: Statsig
description: Statsig is a feature management and experimentation platform for feature gates, dynamic configuration, experiments, metrics, product analytics, and controlled releases.
agentUseSummary: Connect a personal Console API key owned by a dedicated project Read-Only user. Relay approval-gates six versioned Console API reads for bounded gates, dynamic configs, and experiments while removing targeting values, payloads, people, metrics, exposures, and all mutation authority.

credentialRequirements.name: STATSIG_PERSONAL_CONSOLE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Statsig personal Console API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a personal Console API key owned by a dedicated project Read-Only user.

capabilities.label: Read product configuration
capabilities.description: Read bounded, redacted gates, dynamic configs, and experiments with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read Statsig configuration
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded, redacted gates, dynamic configs, and experiments.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Personal Console API keys, Statsig headers, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read targeting or personal data
blocked.description: Target values, user IDs, email/IP values, attributes, overrides, cohorts, parameter/config payloads, metrics, exposures, audit users, and reviewer identities are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Statsig
blocked.description: Gate/config/experiment creation, updates, launch, enable/disable, archive/delete, rules, overrides, reviews, metrics, keys, users, access, and all other mutations remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only six pinned versioned Console API GETs run on statsigapi.net; arbitrary routes, queries, pagination, raw API, HTTP evaluation, SDK initialization, exposure logging, exports, and warehouse access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All six bounded configuration reads require approval; read-only user authority, fixed API version/routes, response bounds, redaction, audits, and mutation/evaluation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected redacted configuration read runs without Relay per-action approval; read-only user authority, fixed API version/routes, response bounds, redaction, audits, and mutation/evaluation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted read-only-user key server-side and mounts six versioned, approval-gated, redacted Console API reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted read-only-user key server-side and mounts six versioned, approval-gated, redacted Console API reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Statsig requires a customer project, a dedicated Read-Only project user, and that user's personal Console API key. No console, account, user, role, key, project, gate, config, experiment, metric, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated Read-Only project user and personal Console API key outside this worker, configure the encrypted key in Railway staging, then verify role/project binding, all six reads and redaction, approval/access denial, 1 MB/25-item bounds, version header, key revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Statsig documents the fixed statsigapi.net Console API origin, STATSIG-API-KEY authentication, current 20240601 version header, CRUD scope, and rate limiting.
Statsig documents personal Console API keys inheriting their owner's project role, project-wide configuration access, secret handling, and the power of non-personal Console keys.
Statsig documents the Read-Only project role as able to read gates, dynamic configs, experiments, and metrics while all attempted configuration edits fail.
Statsig's current reference documents bounded list/read gate routes, pagination, gate state and rollout fields, and sensitive targeting and identity fields Relay removes.
Statsig's current reference documents bounded list/read experiment routes, sparse fieldsets, statuses, groups and project-sensitive experiment metadata.
